row.notes: Renamed from Game_OnlineContract_IsEntrantOtherPlayersExpiringSeat: the old name misses the result; the function returns 1 when only one player takes part or the list at +0x2d0..+0x2d8 is empty, 0 when the lead player is not in co-op, and otherwise the identity match below. Data flow: gets the EntrantRecord list from (+0x270)->vtbl+0x1c8, finds the record with the given id (0x3fff = invalid), requires IsOtherPlayersContractEndingThis(self, rec), then picks a record from the +0x2d0 array by mode +0x290 (1 = element 0, 2 = element 1) and returns Sess_Match_EntrantIdentity(picked, rec). Context from caller: both callers pass the local player entrant id and show the wait-for-other-player message when it returns 0, so it acts as an is-it-my-turn gate; good hook to force 1.
